# Reviewed Regulations.gov test submissions

These are the exact Mirrulations JSON objects captured on September 24, 2026.
Their locators, raw byte hashes, canonical JSON hashes, exclusion reasons and
review date are recorded in `src/spicy_regs/reviewed_comment_exclusions.json`.
The execution log's September 24 CFTC source investigation (deleted with `docs/research` on
2026-11-11; in git history) records the raw-to-staging comparison and live API checks.

The fixtures establish the reviewed observations. A changed payload requires
review; neither a test-like title nor a 404 alone excludes another record.
